api_version: YouTube Analytics API v2 (+ Data API v3 for discovery)

_derivation.note: YouTube Analytics API v2 (reports.query) has a fixed, fully-enumerable metric + dimension vocabulary, transcribed in official_fields.json from https://developers.google.com/youtube/analytics/metrics and /dimensions. No enrichment source (YouTube is not a Supermetrics source). field_discovery.mode=static. The additive core metrics are exposed; ratios, revenue/ads (monetary-scope), playlist/cards/annotations, and the geo/device/traffic/demographic dimensions are cataloged as planned (exhaustive coverage; extraction widens tier by tier).
_derivation.central_design_fact: FULL LIFETIME HISTORY at daily grain (dimensions=day) -- complete from 2013-01-01 (before that, only top-10 videos). The OPPOSITE of Strava/GBP: YouTube is a history-rich, clean daily-additive analytics source, so there is no history cap and a full backfill at connect. Latency: activity finalizes ~2-3 days behind, revenue later -> re-pull a trailing window. Demographics/geo/traffic rows suppressed below privacy thresholds (gaps, not errors).
_derivation.ratio_rule: Ratio metrics (averageViewDuration, averageViewPercentage, cpm, *ClickRate, ...) are NON-ADDITIVE. averageViewDuration is DERIVABLE (estimatedMinutesWatched*60/views) so it is computed at the semantic layer (AD-4), never stored. Non-derivable ratios (averageViewPercentage, cpm) stay planned; when extracted they carry non_additive=true and are never summed.
_derivation.monetary_gate: Revenue + ad metrics (estimatedRevenue, grossRevenue, cpm, adImpressions, monetizedPlaybacks, ...) require the yt-analytics-monetary.readonly scope, requested optionally in the same consent. Cataloged as planned (monetary).

_also._note: GET https://youtubeanalytics.googleapis.com/v2/reports?ids=channel==MINE&startDate=&endDate=&metrics=&dimensions=&filters=&sort=&maxResults=&startIndex= -> {columnHeaders[]:{name,columnType,dataType}, rows[[...]]}. Synchronous. Map by columnHeaders order.
GET https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/channels?part=snippet&mine=true -> channel id + snippet.title (1 quota unit). Reporting-entity discovery.
Scopes yt-analytics.readonly (core), yt-analytics-monetary.readonly (revenue/ads), youtube.readonly (Data API). Data API 10k units/day; Analytics API separate pool + per-100s rate cap.

_no_enrichment: YouTube is NOT a Supermetrics source. The official metrics/dimensions references are the sole authority -- sufficient because the vocabulary is fixed and enumerable.

_field_discovery.note: Fixed metric/dimension vocabulary. Full set committed in api_catalog.json. Enum value sets documented in official_fields.json descriptions + the research dossier annexes.

probe.structural_note: reports.query(ids=channel==MINE, dimensions=day, metrics=<batch>) over a 1-day window: columnHeaders confirm each requested metric/dimension -> ok|empty. Monetary metrics probed only with the monetary scope. Requires a real connected channel; deferred (no test account 2026-07-21).

_verification.note: No YouTube test account (2026-07-21). Ratification deferred: probe channels.list(mine=true) + reports.query for one channel.

reach_reports_2026: 2026-01-15: the Reporting API (bulk) gained channel reach reports (channel_reach_basic_a1, channel_reach_combined_a1) carrying video_thumbnail_impressions and video_thumbnail_impressions_ctr, daily grain, channel level (official revision history). Probed 2026-09-01 with the live connection: reports.query recognises the impressions name but answers 'query not supported' on every channel shape (impressions/ctr stay bulk-only); the Reporting API answers 200 for this token and both reach types are visible once youtubereporting.googleapis.com is enabled on the OAuth project (enabled 2026-09-01). Collection needs the bulk transport (create job -> poll -> download CSV -> land), a NEW extraction path for this connector -- AI-359.
views_counting_change_2026: 2026-08-24: YouTube counts a public view from the FIRST FRAME for every format (long-form, live, podcast, Shorts); the ~30s implicit threshold is gone (official banner, revision history 2026-08-27; monetisation unchanged). The former counting survives as engagedViews ('viewed past the first frame, or clicks/taps to play'), probed 2026-09-02: reports.query serves it (200) with the existing scope. Consequences: `views` is an era-broken series at that date (this project's warehouse currently ends 2026-08-22, entirely pre-break); engaged_views is the continuity metric to collect (AI-371); the governed context event evt_01M1PF6HGVZJQ289FMND2F7H17 (2026-08-24, platform=youtube, metric=views) records the break for the proactive surfaces.
